# Project instructions (synthetic clean fixture)

- Ask for confirmation before running commands that change files.
- Never run commands without asking.
- Do not auto-approve tool calls, and never skip approval prompts.
- Never use --dangerously-skip-permissions.
- Don't ask the user for their password.
- Keep the approval settings as they are.
